description: This file declares the interface for a DataReaderFactory class within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. It defines a pure virtual method for creating IDataReader instances, serving as a factory interface for data reader objects in the Rialto media server component.

classes.name: IDataReaderFactory
classes.description: An interface class defining a factory for creating IDataReader objects, with a pure virtual method createDataReader.

methods.name: createDataReader
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a shared pointer to an IDataReader, given media source type, data pointer, data offset, and number of frames.
